items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Mel Lewis's musical style and inspiration ('Tiny') and mentions Mel Tormé ('Mel told me it’s his favorite record'), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Mel Lewis himself, other than acknowledging his reputation.

ctx.x: Well he and Mel Lewis were very close.
Well that was Mel's original inspiration, Tiny, that's who Mel wanted to be like and he was right.
Yeah, they’re not interchangeable, I mean…
